Solar Design Engineer

2Coms Consulting Pvt Ltd · All areas in Bengaluru/Bangalore Region

9,00,000 - 9,36,000 monthly

Job description

We are hiring a Solar Design Engineer to prepare rooftop solar layouts using AutoCAD and PVsyst, size inverters and cables, and coordinate with the installation team on site. Responsibilities include site surveys, shading analysis, single line diagrams and preparing the bill of materials for each project.

Requirements: a diploma or bachelor degree in electrical engineering, one to three years of experience in solar design, working knowledge of AutoCAD and MS Excel, and willingness to travel to project sites within Karnataka.

Key skills

AutoCAD, PVsyst, Solar Design, Electrical Engineering
